geometry: MPFB / MakeHuman human base mesh, official game-engine rig and official MHCLO clothes and hair
animation: Locally authored bone-keyframe Idle, Cheer, Disappointed
axes: Y up, +Z facing, meters; model feet at Y~0
intended_use: Three anonymous human spectators; no celebrity identities. High detail for broadcast close-up, separate decimated LOD for stadium crowd
limitations: Game-ready textured human models, not photoreal scanned actors or filmed spectators.

motion_update.source: Carnegie Mellon University Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
changes: Replaced authored Idle/Cheer/Disappointed clips with captured seated, rising, standing, happy and sad performances.
Retargeted proportions and calibrated shoe soles to captured foot contact height.
Hands follow forearms; fingers use a relaxed unmeasured pose because CMU finger channels are not recorded.
Most spectators are seated. Reactions start at different times; no continuous whole-body bouncing.
Seated posture was selected from the high-stool recording after rejecting the low stool take for this scene. Seat surfaces match the captured hip height.
limitations: Background spectators use a limited set of baked captured poses rather than full per-person animation.
